name: In'yaku Izon Gakuen ~Motto... Motto Choudai!~
original_name: 淫薬依存学園～もっと…もっとちょうだい！～
source:
Sayaka Hibino is an idol.
She lives a busy life, but at school, she’s just an ordinary girl.
Or, at least, that’s the life she wants to lead, but things aren’t quite so simple.

Terrified that her fans might abandon her, she is always graceful to them, even if she encounters a fan at school, and does not dare reveal any displeasure on her face when around them.

This is the way in which she lives her life... but on the inside, she’s absolutely exhausted.

---

Toshiya Yazaki is a chemistry teacher at that school.
As his occupation might suggest, he’s very skilled when it comes to mixing chemicals.
But he also has a perverse hobby of sorts. He likes to use his chemicals to turn any girl that takes his fancy into his slave.
“My next target... is gonna be you...”

Toshiya sets his sights on Sayaka... the poor girl whose exhaustion has almost reached its limit.
And so he plans to give her his sinister concoction.

[From [url=https://www.johren.games/games/download/inyakuizongakuenmottomottoc-ja/]Johren[/url]]
translation:
日比野纱耶香是一名偶像。
她过着忙碌的生活，但在学校里，她只想当一个普通女孩。
至少，她希望如此，可现实并没有那么简单。

纱耶香害怕粉丝抛弃自己，因此总是以优雅的态度对待他们；即使在学校里遇到粉丝，她也不敢在对方面前露出半点不悦。

她一直以这种方式生活……内心却早已疲惫不堪。

——

矢崎利哉是这所学校的化学老师。
正如职业所暗示的那样，他非常擅长调配化学药剂。
但他还有一种变态嗜好：喜欢用自己的药物，把任何看中的女孩变成奴隶。
“我的下一个目标……就是你……”

利哉盯上了纱耶香……这个身心疲惫、几乎已经到达极限的可怜女孩。
于是，他计划让她服下那剂邪恶的药物。
